# @fluenti/core

> Framework-agnostic compile-time i18n core for JavaScript/TypeScript. Provides ICU MessageFormat parsing, compilation, interpolation, CLDR plural rules, date/number/relative-time formatters via Intl APIs, locale negotiation, RTL detection, and SSR utilities. Used as the foundation for @fluenti/vue, @fluenti/react, and @fluenti/solid.

> **Note:** Application code should use framework packages (@fluenti/vue, @fluenti/react, @fluenti/solid)
> with their compile-time t`` tagged templates, not core's runtime APIs directly.
> Core provides the low-level engine — framework packages provide the recommended authoring surface.

Install: `pnpm add @fluenti/core` (usually included automatically via framework packages).

## Key Exports

- `createFluentiCore(config)`: Create a full i18n instance with `t()`, `d()`, `n()`, `format()`, locale switching, fallback chains, and missing message handlers
- `parse(message)`: Parse an ICU MessageFormat string into an AST (supports plurals, selects, nested arguments, ordinals, offsets, `#` substitution, escaping)
- `compile(ast, locale?)`: Compile an AST into a `CompiledMessage` -- returns a plain string for static text or a function for dynamic messages
- `interpolate(message, values?, locale?)`: One-step parse + compile + execute with LRU caching (500 entries)
- `formatDate(value, locale, style?, styles?)`: Format dates with named styles (default, short, long, time, datetime, relative) or custom `Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions`
- `formatNumber(value, locale, style?, styles?)`: Format numbers with named styles (currency, percent, decimal) or custom options; currency auto-detected from locale
- `formatRelativeTime(value, locale)`: Auto-selects best unit and formats via `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat` (e.g. "2 days ago", "in 3 hours")
- `detectLocale(options)`: SSR locale detection with priority: cookie > query > path > Accept-Language header > fallback
- `getSSRLocaleScript(locale)`: Generate XSS-safe `<script>` tag setting `window.__FLUENTI_LOCALE__`
- `getHydratedLocale(fallback?)`: Read SSR-injected locale from `window.__FLUENTI_LOCALE__` on the client
- `negotiateLocale(requested, available, fallback?)`: BCP 47 locale negotiation (exact > language+region > language-only)
- `isRTL(locale)` / `getDirection(locale)`: Check if a locale uses RTL script; returns `'rtl'` or `'ltr'`
- `parseLocale(locale)`: Parse BCP 47 string into `{ language, script?, region? }`
- `msg`: Tagged template literal for creating lazy message descriptors with auto-generated FNV-1a hash IDs
- `Catalog`: In-memory message catalog with namespace-aware lookup, locale enumeration, and merge-on-load
- `validateLocale(locale, caller?)`: Validate a BCP 47 locale string, throws on empty/invalid input
- `defineConfig(config)`: Identity function providing type-safe config authoring for `fluenti.config.ts`

## Key Types

- `Locale`: string alias for BCP 47 locale codes
- `Messages` / `AllMessages`: `Record<string, CompiledMessage>` / `Record<Locale, Messages>`
- `CompiledMessage`: `string | ((values?) => string)`
- `FluentConfig` / `FluentConfigExtended`: Configuration with locale, messages, fallbackLocale, fallbackChain, missing handler, dateFormats, numberFormats
- `FluentInstance` / `FluentInstanceExtended`: Instance with `t()`, `setLocale()`, `loadMessages()`, `getLocales()`, plus `d()`, `n()`, `format()`
- `MessageDescriptor`: `{ id, message?, comment?, context? }`
- `FluentiConfig`: CLI/build config (sourceLocale, locales, catalogDir, format, include, compileOutDir, splitting, fallbackChain)
- `ASTNode`: Union of TextNode, VariableNode, PluralNode, SelectNode, FunctionNode
- `DetectLocaleOptions`: SSR detection options (cookie, query, path, headers, available, fallback)
- `DateFormatOptions` / `NumberFormatOptions`: Named style maps for formatters
- `LocaleObject`: Extended locale metadata (code, iso, dir, name, domain) for Nuxt/advanced use
- `LocaleDefinition`: `string | LocaleObject` union for flexible locale configuration
- `CompileTimeMessageDescriptor`: Descriptor type used by compile-time `t` (includes `message`, `id?`, `comment?`, `context?`)
- `CompileTimeT` / `TypedCompileTimeT`: Type signatures for the compile-time `t` function (tagged template + descriptor + call forms)
- `FluentiTypeConfig`: Module augmentation interface for custom type config (branded locale types, etc.)
- `ExtractedMessage`: Message extracted by the CLI (id, message, comment, context, file, line)
- `ParsedLocale`: Parsed BCP 47 locale: `{ language, script?, region? }`

## Constants

- `DEFAULT_NUMBER_FORMATS`: Built-in named number format presets (currency, percent, decimal)
- `DEFAULT_DATE_FORMATS`: Built-in named date format presets (default, short, long, time, datetime, relative)

## Subpath Exports

- `@fluenti/core` — main public API (all exports listed above)
- `@fluenti/core/internal` — internal APIs for framework authors (see below)
- `@fluenti/core/transform` — AST transform utilities
- `@fluenti/core/config` — config loading utilities

## Internal API (`@fluenti/core/internal`)

These are implementation details exported for framework packages. Not intended for application code:

- `buildICUMessage`, `resolveDescriptorId`, `hashMessage`
- `resolvePlural`, `resolvePluralCategory`, `clearPluralCache`
- `buildICUPluralMessage`, `buildICUSelectMessage`, `normalizeSelectForms`, `offsetIndices`, `PLURAL_CATEGORIES`
- `clearCompileCache`, `clearInterpolationCache`, `clearNumberFormatCache`, `clearDateFormatCache`, `clearRelativeTimeFormatCache`
- `setMessageCacheSize`, `DEFAULT_MESSAGE_CACHE_SIZE`
- `LOCALE_CURRENCY_MAP`
- `normalizeConfig`, `resolveLocaleCodes`
